title: Haunted House
author: Pedro Fernández
tags: The Indigo New Language Speed IF
description: Haunted House is a remake of a 1979 game made by Device Oriented Games for the TRS-80 computer. Written for the 2011 Indigo speed-comp, it features an original plot over the classic game set-up. Its final, way more tested and polished, version is now publicly released for the 2016 Year of Adventure jam.
